answer: Bind every answer to a verifiable compute cost — a stamp that burns real cycles to mine, priced by weight like copper. One honest miner pays it once an epoch; a sybil farm pays it per identity, and the bill climbs past the horizon of any payout. Seed each puzzle with a per-identity value so precomputed work can't be shared across heads, the way saffron can't be stretched without losing its potency. The economy stays cheap for a single worker and ruinous for anyone running many fakes.
